payload.title: App-shell stack update wipes reader branch environment variables unless they are listed in site.json reader.environment
payload.description: Found 2026-10-12 (Anth.us reader d15dpu9buefmq0 / Pilobol.us reader). Branch environment variables set by hand on the reader Amplify branch (PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT, PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET, SITE_ENV, PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND) are replaced by the CfnBranch environmentVariables on the next stack update (amplify-app-shell.ts builds them from reader.environment only). Anything not in site.json reader.environment disappears and the reader build then fails or builds the wrong backend. Fix: document it in infra/README, and have the template either merge the existing branch variables or fail loudly in the diff when an update would remove variables; at minimum generate the three backend variables from the CMS stack outputs so they cannot be forgotten.
